summary.traderNote: ERCOT is currently running close to forecast. load is 722 MW above forecast, solar is 475 MW above forecast, and wind is 176 MW below forecast. Actual net load is therefore about 423 MW higher than expected. RT hub prices are trading $13.41/MWh above day-ahead, suggesting the market is pricing tighter real-time conditions. Risk label is Normal; the transparent inputs are not flashing material stress.
